title: Five arrested as counter-terror police investigate major incident near RAF Fairford
description: The men have been detained on suspicion of preparation of a terrorist act after three suspicious vehicles were reported to be travelling towards the base.

title: What we know about RAF Fairford counter-terror probe
description: Five men have been arrested as counter-terror police lead an investigation into a major incident near the airbase.

title: Burnham proposes NHS-style social care system for England
description: The prime minister told the BBC that social care in England is "as unfair as American healthcare".

title: Orange Order march row goes to heart of ongoing divisions in Northern Ireland
description: The dispute over the controversial parade is a reminder that the peace process is not over.

title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
description: In rare access to Yemen's conflict zone the BBC travels to the front line with pro-government soldiers.

title: No handshakes between Republic of Ireland and Israel
description: The Republic of Ireland and Israel players do not shake hands with each other before or after Sunday's controversial Uefa Nations League game in Hungary.

title: Ten NHS staff removed over Noah Woods data breach
description: East Suffolk and North Essex NHS Foundation Trust says it has launched an "urgent" investigation.

title: England win series as Banton delivers on potential
description: Tom Banton delivers on all of his potential by crashing a brilliant first international century as England wrapped up their summer with an ODI series win over Sri Lanka.

title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 27 dead
description: The two attacks hours apart come as the country struggles to stop high levels of gang-related armed violence.
